list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase and PSNProfiles)

roadmap.title: Roadmap to the platinum — about 200 hours, 1 playthrough, 0 online trophies

stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story
stages.blurb: Finish all five chapters and do the side content as it appears. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots + 1 autosave). Turn on progress and collectible notifications in Settings. The one thing you must not skip: Lucia’s balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

stages.title: Stage 2 — 100% completion
stages.blurb: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list. It is about 60% true completion — most things are only partly required. Robberies, vaults, gang operations, underwater discoveries, Shooting Range golds, drone races and Bret’s 15 Target Decks are required in full.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
stages.blurb: Finish the 8 stranger strands and anything left. Nothing here is needed for 100%, and it all stays available after the story. Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the other 54 are earned.

warnings: Cheats disable trophies and saving — leave them off for the whole run.
There is no mission replay. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter.
The Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent — do not push violence to the extreme.
One trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude (Chapter 1 balcony meditation).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of everything else: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task — finish the story, the 100% checklist and the miscellaneous trophies, and this is the reward. Budget about 200 hours in total.
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1-5)
Reach 100% completion (A Long Road)
Clean up Strangers & Freaks and the miscellaneous trophies
This trophy pops automatically once the other 54 are done

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is automatic and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Gone Fishing
The trophy pops at the end of the mission

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy actually pops after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so do not worry if it does not appear the moment the chapter ends.
steps: Complete every Chapter 1 mission
Start Chapter 2 — the trophy pops after What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It pops as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City.
steps: Complete every Chapter 2 mission
Play Welcome to Vice City — the trophy pops then

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
steps: Complete every Chapter 3 mission
Play Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops when the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero, is done and Chapter 5 begins.
steps: Complete every Chapter 4 mission
Finish Starting From Zero

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Free roam continues afterwards, so nothing else is locked behind the credits.
steps: Play through to the end of Chapter 5
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy — automatic.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 2
Finish the mission

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy — automatic.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3
Finish the mission

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy — automatic.
steps: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4
Finish the mission

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy — automatic.
steps: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4
Finish the mission

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy — automatic.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4
Finish the mission

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy — automatic.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5
Finish the mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist only appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but everything you do before then already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is closer to 60% true completion: most things are only partly required. In full: every robbery (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), all underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret’s 15 Target Decks. In part: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.
steps: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list
Robberies, vaults and gang operations: all of them
Shooting Ranges: gold in all 42; drone races: all 42; Bret’s Target Decks: all 15
Partials: 100 optional missions, 200 vehicle scans, 100 animal studies, 15 meditations, 70 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans
trophies.unconfirmed: KeenGamer lists 15 complete card sets among the collectibles where GTABase lists Bret’s 15 Target Decks. The in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) is the authority — check it after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts out of 397: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories freely; flying under bridges is the fastest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.
steps: Pick any mix of the 4 categories to reach 250
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest
Track progress: Progress > Activities > Stunts (R3 for progress by region); Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots lists them by name

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Check what is left under Progress > Activities; most come naturally while chasing other trophies.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see the 9 types
Do each once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade game, a race win, a stunt

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges
Gold all 42 challenges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough here, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there.
steps: Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations
For 100%, win all 42 races

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of 40. Winning the same race again does not count.
steps: Win 20 different races — car races, race challenges or drone races count

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.
steps: Finish Feng Shui in Chapter 1
Follow Cal's text to the purple fishing spot west of Key Lento
Complete his fishing quests and beat him

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are 4: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida. You must finish all levels of one game at least once; the extra challenges are not needed.
steps: Pick any of the 4 games
Finish all its levels — challenges optional

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Lucia-only, starting in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her an address in Belville. Five missions in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. All still available after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 until Andy calls
Follow the Belville address
Complete all 5 missions in order

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. He hires you in Chapter 1 (green KR icon in Key Lento) to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so it can be finished then. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
steps: Meet Kenton in Key Lento (Chapter 1)
Dive the 7 shipwrecks, metal detector on the ocean floor
Turn in each set — he calls you back for the next

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy. They stay available after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub
Complete all 5 jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed — check the progress counter in your trophy list. None are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.
steps: Finish Kirk's strand (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove)
Finish Kyle's strand (McKittrick Farm)
Finish Yago's strand (street races)
Finish Pilot Pete's strand (deliveries)
Complete 4 more qualifying strands — watch the trophy counter
trophies.unconfirmed: More qualifying strands are still being confirmed by both cited guides; the four named here are the confirmed ones.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which gives you the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Chapter 3) to get the Key Cloner
Deliver the 16 cars on Randy's Wish List to his west Vice City garage
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to check the list; hunt around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach hotels

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy.
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), as Jason
Destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs (Take Out Kitty Litter)
Finish Shut Down the Labs

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it — do it to be safe.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — the morning after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept
Meditate at all 18 spots (with both characters together counts double)
The final spot needs both characters — available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2)
trophies.unconfirmed: It is not confirmed whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required for the trophy — both cited guides say to do it to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), wait for Bret's text as Jason
Start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County
Hunt the Target Deck animals (purple icons) and bring them to Bret
trophies.unconfirmed: Which animal exactly triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet by either cited guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. You do not need all of them — any 3 count. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
steps: Find collectible cards across Leonida
Complete any 3 sets — track them in Progress > Collections

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan)
Scan any 100 locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.
steps: Work through challenges — Progress > Challenges shows ticks
Complete any 50 (70 for 100%)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle), get a 4-star wanted level and escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner (hold Right, Triangle)
Build a 4-star wanted level
Escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel works well

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
steps: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3), bring your partner
Rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level flashes red and blue
Loot a couple of items per store; if it does not pop after ~30 seconds, hit a 4th

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you'll get this anyway.
steps: Open the WAiNK app near a busy road
Scan 100 different vehicles — driving them is not needed

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming — it slows time for a few seconds. Fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
steps: Fill Focus (eat/drink/wash up; Adrenaline extends it)
Find 5 gang-operation thugs grouped together
Aim, click L3+R3, drop all 5 in one Combat Focus

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
steps: Go to VCIA, gates E3/E4
Board a jet docked at the bridge (stairs by the bridge)
Back out, take off, fly 1 km from the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks are at the south end of the base — and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, south end of the base
Steal a Rhino tank
Shoot enemies from inside it

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun — use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room too. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) for the Snap Gun
Snap Gun the back door — don't kick it
Find the safe code note, empty the safe, destroy the footage, disable the alarm

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That’s Where The Money Is…: follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
steps: Finish That’s Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4)
Follow a security van to a bank; enter while the vault is open
Hand a bag to your partner; escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles
Rob 5 vaults (all 8 for 100%)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way: robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults unlock, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape the heat zone (counts as an armored truck robbery)
Or: box in an armored truck, sticky bomb its back doors, escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map (52 areas). The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch.
steps: Get a plane
Fly over every fogged patch until the map is fully revealed

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39.
steps: Find yellow-icon illegal operations on the map
Rob one for each of the 9 gangs (all 39 for 100%)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach
Buy an Apple Martini
Drink it standing next to the bar
trophies.unconfirmed: GTABase still lists this trophy as unconfirmed; the steps above follow PowerPyx, which published them with screenshots.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — only after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, drive forward straight through the window. The trophy pops a little after you drive away. Only the blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3: Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs)
Go to the south Vice City showroom and hack the blue Banshee
Drive straight through the showroom window
trophies.unconfirmed: GTABase still lists this trophy as unconfirmed; the steps above follow PowerPyx, which published them with screenshots.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit — the robbery respawns after a long time, so you can come back for the rest.
steps: Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation
During Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2), take the watch, the shotgun and the safe
Lose the police — the trophy pops then

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities, dumbbell icon) with your partner along — training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner
Work out together at a fitness club — training one trains both
Max Strength on both characters

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count — click the trophy in the trophy list to see your progress. Don't push towards the Irredeemable profile: it's permanent.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI)
Play normally — robberies and encounters count
If you're short at the end, the count climbs fastest from robberies and fights

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. NOT CONFIRMED YET: as of 20 Nov 2026 no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. The leading theory (PowerPyx) is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner — in Little Cuba, Vice City. Don't grind for it blindly; check back once a guide confirms it.
steps: Not confirmed — no verified steps yet
Leading theory: the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba (prologue location)
Re-check the cited guides before spending time on it
trophies.unconfirmed: No published guide has confirmed the unlock as of 20 Nov 2026. GTABase also lists it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2 AM, go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.
steps: At night after 2 AM, go solo to the road NW of Starlet Motel, Kelly County
Look for the blinking car; if absent, drive away and return
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it
Talk to the dropped woman, offer help, return to her car

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
steps: Get any bike
Ride through a crowded area (Vice City or Ocean Beach)
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It's a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
steps: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) for the Dye Pack Jammer
Rob banks and Payday Loans
Sell the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most) until $250,000

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. A running total across every kind of shop — guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.
steps: Spend $100,000 total across any shops
Fastest: guns, car mods, tattoos

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you don't count.
steps: After Daily Driver (Chapter 2), open the Vice City Real Estate app
Buy all 8 garages (~$160,000 total)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Take stolen vehicles to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
steps: Finish Moses (Chapter 2) to get the Scooter Bros app
Buy garage space first (Little Boxes)
Take stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn — Respray, then Register
Register 10 (cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down)
